title: VOYVOY Sunday Open Mic & Jam
description: Live music, open mic, and jam night at VOYVOY in Cabarete. Lester Grant kicks it off — bring an instrument or borrow one. Relaxed drinks and dinner spot.

title: VOYVOY Saturday Session
description: Saturday night dance session at VOYVOY with guest DJs — reggaeton, dance club vibes, no cover. A Cabarete staple for locals and visitors.

title: La Chabola Wednesday Open Mic
description: Wednesday open mic at La Chabola in Callejón de la Loma, Cabarete — local musicians, stone-oven pizza, and a neighborhood crowd. Bring a song or just listen; doors from late afternoon, music into the night.

title: Domingos Pal Pueblo at Ground Zero
description: Sunday party nights at Ground Zero Discoteca — reggaeton, dembow, baile típico, and urban hits with DJs all night, whisky half-price, and hookah. On the Puerto Plata–Sosúa highway opposite the airport. Reserve a table: 849-465-1313.
address: Km 18, Carretera Puerto Plata–Sosúa, frente al Aeropuerto Gregorio Luperón

title: Viernes Locos at Ground Zero
description: Crazy Fridays at Ground Zero Discoteca — whisky half-price and a late Sosúa party night on the Puerto Plata–Sosúa highway opposite the airport. Reserve a table: 849-465-1313.
address: Km 18, Carretera Puerto Plata–Sosúa, frente al Aeropuerto Gregorio Luperón

title: Party Rojo at Ground Zero
description: Ground Zero presents Party Rojo — Saturday Aug 1 red-dress theme night on the Puerto Plata–Sosúa highway opposite the airport. First 25 women in a red dress enter free; call for cover and table reservations: 849-465-1313.
address: Km 18, Carretera Puerto Plata–Sosúa, frente al Aeropuerto Gregorio Luperón

title: Lil Naay — Live at Disco Club
description: Dominican urban star Lil Naay live at Disco Club (Depósitos de Brugal, Calle Duarte) — Friday Jul 17, 8–11 PM. Pre-sale RD$700 on todotickets.do (service included); electronic QR entry at the door.

title: Lena Dardelet × Pororó — De Aquí Pa'llá
description: French-Dominican singer-songwriter Lena Dardelet and Pororó open their national De Aquí Pa'llá tour at Aura Beach Club on Cabarete's Calle Principal — Friday Jul 24, 8 PM AST. Free entry with RSVP on tix.do.

title: Cabarete Jazz Festival 2026
description: Second edition of Cabarete Jazz Festival (Sat Jun 6) — Alfredo Rodríguez, Cimafunk, Los Amigos Invisibles, iLe, Gia Fu, and Dominican saxophonist Sandy Gabriel. Open-air Caribbean jazz produced by Cabarete Tango and Mishu Music; gates from 5 PM. Tickets at cabaretejazz.com.

title: Jandy Ventura — El Legado del Caballo
description: Jandy Ventura brings the Johnny Ventura merengue tribute “El Legado del Caballo” to the Blue JackTar convention center in Playa Dorada. Tickets sold locally at Supermercado José Luis, Tío Pan, Blue JackTar, and La Locanda — Front Stage RD$5,000 · VIP RD$4,000 · General RD$2,500. Produced by GRAAN Events Planners.

title: Rumble in Paradise 12
description: Professional boxing on Sosúa Beach at Bar 39, with special guest appearances and autograph signings.

description: Al Sena Athletics Survival Series basketball — Club Deportivo Fantastico (CDF) vs Dracos. VIP Game 1 of five Saturday nights (Jul 18 – Aug 15): reserved seating, meal voucher, and drinks. Tickets on Eventbrite.

title: Cabarete Classic 2026
description: Four days of windsurf, kitesurf, wingfoil, and foil racing on Cabarete Beach (Jul 16–19). The Caribbean's flagship water-sports regatta — international competitors, clinics, and evening music on the beach.

title: Puerto Plata Golf Classic 2026
description: 13th edition of Ashonorte's Puerto Plata Golf Classic — scramble pairs tournament at Playa Dorada Golf Course on Saturday Jul 18, with a Night Putting Challenge and categories named for North Coast towns (Puerto Plata, Sosúa, Cabarete, La Isabela). Registration US$210 via the golf club; call +1 809 320 4262.

title: CAC Games Surf — Playa Encuentro
description: Surf competitions for the XXV Central American and Caribbean Games Santo Domingo 2026 at Playa Encuentro, Cabarete (Jul 25–29). Shortboard, longboard, and SUP Surf for men and women — 71 athletes from 12 countries on the North Coast's signature break. Most CAC competitions are free for spectators; organizers: +1 829 893 4214.

title: Puerto Plata Beach Soccer 2026
description: Second edition of Puerto Plata Beach Soccer at Playa Los Charamicos, Sosúa (Aug 21–23). Six senior teams and six U-15 sides compete over three family-friendly days promoting beach soccer and North Coast sports tourism. Free beach spectating; team/info inquiries +1 809 586 6125.

title: 11th Sosúa 10K Road Race
description: 11th annual Sosúa 10K organized by the Sosúa Sustainable Development Association (ADSS) — a 10K through downtown El Batey plus a children's 1K (under 12). Starts Sunday Oct 11 at 6:45 AM at Parque Las Flores; register by Oct 7 midnight on sdctickets.do from RD$500. Spectators welcome. Info: +1 809 571 2100 · WhatsApp +1 829 546 7528.
address: Parque Las Flores, El Batey, Sosúa

title: Puerto Plata Poker Experience (CLSOP)
description: Ten-day Caribbean poker festival at Coral Reef Casino in Sosúa Bay Center (Aug 28–Sep 6) — 15 tournaments in US dollars, cash games, and an NLH Main Event with a US$100,000 guarantee (US$900 buy-in, unlimited re-entries). Oceanfront series on the CLSOP circuit.
address: Dr. Alejo Martínez #1, Edif. Sosúa Bay Center, El Batey, Sosúa

title: Aventúrate RD 2026
description: Second edition of Aventúrate RD, the North Coast's adventure- and eco-tourism business fair, at Hotel Marién in Puerto Plata (Sep 2–4). 60+ exhibitors and 200+ international buyers, plus forums, business rounds, and a gastronomic closing in Sosúa. Organized by AFEET RD and CDCT; register at feriaaventuraterd.com.

title: Sunset Cabarete Sessions
description: Two-day beachfront deep-house sessions at Lux Beach Bar on Playa Cabarete (Dec 5–6) — kite surf by day, sunset transitions, resident DJs, and German guest Acid Pauli. Barefoot, 18+, local craft beer; 2 PM–1 AM. Tickets from US$16 on Ticketplus.

title: Women's Reconnection Kite Camp
description: 7-night women's kite camp on Cabarete beachfront — flow, reconnect, and kite sessions with IKO instructor Ariadna Rabasa. Early bird spots available.

title: 18th Annual Cabarete Butterfly Effect
description: Five-day women's watersports festival across Cabarete (Jul 7–11): SUP clinics, yoga, beach cleanup, catamaran cruise, and the signature river paddle. See the official site for schedule and registration.

title: Sancocho Saturdays at Pingüi
description: Saturdays taste like tradition at Pingüi Bar — share a bowl of sancocho facing the sea at Playa El Pueblito. Gather friends and family for an afternoon of Dominican comfort food and ocean views (12–4 PM).
venue: Pingüi Bar Restaurant & Piña Colada House

title: Feria Artesanal Verano 2026
description: The Summer Artisan Fair 2026 runs July 10–26 at Plaza Independencia (Puerto Plata's Central Park). More than 120 local artisans exhibit daily from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM — handmade pieces, cultural displays, art, souvenirs, and cabezudos masks. A showcase of Dominican crafts for visitors and residents alike.

title: Puerto Plata Carnival 2026
description: Puerto Plata Carnival 2026 on the Malecón — Sunday parades every February (Feb 1, 8, 15 & 22) culminating in the Gran Desfile Final on March 1 at Anfiteatro La Puntilla. Taimáscaro masks, comparsas, and Dominican folk culture on the North Coast.
venue: Malecón de Puerto Plata & Anfiteatro La Puntilla

title: Malecón Morning Wellness Walk
description: Early-morning walkers and joggers along Puerto Plata's Malecón — ocean breezes, stretching groups, and a daily wellness ritual on the waterfront promenade from La Puntilla to the city center.

title: Pilates Reformer Group Class
description: Group Pilates Reformer sessions in Cabarete with Rafaella Cirillo (Tue & Thu 9 AM). Studio address shared when you book — DM or WhatsApp +1 809 460 5777. Discount code RC-pilates for first class.

title: El Colibri Karaoke Battle — Thursdays
description: Thursday karaoke nights at El Colibri Hotel, Sosúa (7 PM–midnight). Join the 8-week Karaoke Battle — $20,000 in prizes (Jul 2–Sep 3, 2026). Contestants must attend every Thursday to stay eligible. Register on WhatsApp: +1 917-523-7259.

title: Inicio del Campamento
description: Sports camp kickoff in historic San Felipe, Puerto Plata — hosted by Sin pelos en la lengua. Check the Facebook event for registration details.

title: Silent Run 5K — Malecón Puerto Plata
description: Immersive 5K along the Puerto Plata Malecón with wireless headphones synced to a live DJ — hosted by Aleva Experiences. Meet at Victrola 037 Arte Café; neon after-party, raffles, and prizes after the route. Tickets from RD$950 on boletu.com (phases sold out — join the waitlist).
address: Av. Gral. Gregorio Luperón esq. Padre Castellanos, Puerto Plata 57000

title: Sunset Night Party — One Event, Two Experiences
description: Beach sunset-to-late party at Bonsai Poke on Playa Encuentro, Cabarete — Saturday Jul 25. Sunset session 5–9 PM, night party from 9 PM with HYPER, ALDENKINGS, and TAÏF. Early bird RD$500 (welcome drink; 70 tickets). Produced by SONIK Productions; also welcomes CAC Games 2026 surf, longboard, and SUP athletes. Tickets on tix.do.

title: LOS Event — Trilogy Labor Day Weekend
description: Multi-day Labor Day 2026 party takeover by Trilogy World at VIP Beach Lifestyles Resort and Spa (Cofresí) — Sep 3–7. NYC entertainment group DJs and nightlife for the holiday weekend on Puerto Plata's west coast.
venue: VIP Beach Lifestyles Resort and Spa

title: Sunset Laughter Club
description: Reina (Dominicated) hosts a 30-minute laughter club on Cabarete beach — Tuesdays from Jul 28 at 6:30 PM. Meet at the Ocean One beach entrance in the heart of Cabarete; bring water and wear comfortable clothes.

title: Huelga-Velada Pacífica — No Maltrato Animal
description: Peaceful strike-vigil against animal abuse at the entrance to Torre Alta in Puerto Plata — Friday Aug 7 at 6:30 PM. Community candlelight gathering in response to recent pet poisonings in Torre Alta II; free and open. Slogan: “No es solo por ellos, es por todos.”

title: Bingo Night at Chill & Grill
description: Bingo tonight at Chill & Grill Bar & Eatery in Casa Linda (Sosúa) — Monday Aug 3 from 6:30 PM. Community tip from Everything Sosúa; message the venue on WhatsApp to confirm cards and cover.
address: Casa Linda Villas Phase 7-9, Carretera El Choco, Sosúa 57000

title: Cigar Town Sessions — Acústico & Humos
description: Live acoustic night at Cigar Town Pop in Puerto Plata — Eddy Almonte and Café Meclao for Cigar Town Sessions: Acústico & Humos. Friday Aug 14 at Av. Luis Ginebra No. 56. Confirm start time with the lounge via Instagram @cigartownpop.
address: Avenida Luis Ginebra No. 56, Puerto Plata

title: Congreso de Damas ADN 2026 — Mujer, Vive sin Temor
description: Women's congress of the Asociación Dominicana del Norte (ADN / Ministerio de la Mujer ADN) at all-inclusive Gran Ventana Beach Resort in Playa Dorada — Oct 2–4 under the theme “Mujer, Vive sin Temor / Bajo el manto de Su gracia.” Registration RD$2,000 (limited capacity); room packages from RD$13,200–16,900 per person. ADN offices: +1 809 582 6688; Directora MM Nancy Vera: +1 809 501 5074.
address: Complejo Hotelero Playa Dorada, Puerto Plata 57000

title: Master of the Ocean 2026
description: 21st Master of the Ocean on Kite Beach, Cabarete — Sep 16–20. The world's only five-discipline tropical ocean contest: surf, kitesurf, windsurf, SUP, and wingfoil. Spectating from the sand is free; after-parties and the cultural hub run through the week. Official site masteroftheocean.org.
